description: This file defines the 'ClientControllerImpl' class, which implements the 'google::protobuf::RpcController' interface for managing RPC calls within the 'firebolt::rialto::ipc' namespace. It includes method declarations for controlling RPC behavior, error handling, and cancellation, along with private members for internal state management.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the RpcController interface for client-side RPC control, including methods for resetting, failure checking, error reporting, cancellation, and internal state management.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the RPC controller to its initial state, allowing reuse for a new call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the previous RPC call has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error from the last failed RPC call.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Initiates cancellation of the ongoing RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state with a reason string; intended for server-side use.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled by the client.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC is canceled.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Private method to mark the method call as failed with a reason.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Overloaded private method to mark the method call as failed with a formatted message.
